title: Use Modifications in the Special Hunts Point District
previewText: In the Special Hunts Point District, transient hotels or motels listed under Use Group V shall not be permitted within the areas designated on the Special Hunts Point District Map in Appendix A. Within such areas, Section 74-153 (In M1 Districts) shall not be applicable.
